notes: Standard x64 runner (AMD EPYC 9454P; 2 vCPU = 1 physical core). Premium runners are enabled by default at the account level: with that setting on, jobs using these standard labels are routed to premium machines and billed at the premium rate ($0.03/min, see premium-30-x64), falling back to standard (and the standard rate) when premium capacity is full. Turn premium off in the console to always pay this price.
